# Gireevan Realty

> Gireevan Realty markets Nature Nest, a real-estate project in Revoli-Pen, Raigad, Maharashtra, offering NA-approved residential plots and custom bungalow packages with site-visit booking and contact details.

Use the links below as the primary source for project information on this website.

Important notes:
- Pricing, availability, and package details can change. Use the contact page for the latest enquiry path.
- "NA plot" on this site refers to non-agricultural land approved for residential use, as explained on the plots page.
- The links below point to the canonical HTML pages currently published on the site.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://gireevan.com/): Project overview for Nature Nest, including positioning, highlights, plot pricing from INR 1,399 per sq ft onwards, and bungalow package entry points.
- [NA Plots](https://gireevan.com/na-plots.html): Details on NA-approved plots, plot-size configurations, legal context, documents, and the booking journey.
- [Luxury Bungalows](https://gireevan.com/bungalows.html): Bungalow concepts, design philosophy, typologies, and villa-plus-plot package context.
- [Location](https://gireevan.com/location.html): Revoli-Pen, Raigad location details, connectivity, travel times, and address information.
- [Master Plan](https://gireevan.com/master-plan.html): Site layout with plot numbering, roads, open areas, and amenity zones.
- [Gallery](https://gireevan.com/gallery.html): Visual reference for plots, bungalows, amenities, and the surrounding landscape.
- [Contact](https://gireevan.com/contact.html): Site visit booking, phone, email, address, visit hours, and enquiry form.
